The Beginning

Our Story

Founded by passionate Balinese locals, Bali West Transport was born from a simple belief: every traveler deserves to experience the real Bali, not just the tourist spots.

We started with a single car and a dream to share our island's beauty with the world. Today, we've helped thousands of travelers from Europe, America, and Australia discover the magic of Bali.

What sets us apart? We listen. Whether you want to chase waterfalls, explore ancient temples, or simply relax on pristine beaches, we craft experiences that match your vision.
